entities.summary: Ivan Igorevich Prosvetov is a Russian professional ice hockey player who is a goaltender for the Calgary Wranglers of the American Hockey League (AHL) while under contract to the Calgary Flames of the National Hockey League (NHL). Prosvetov was selected by the Arizona Coyotes, 114th overall, in the 2018 NHL entry draft.
